text_block_list.text: What did you think, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Did I succeed in leading by example?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Then I am satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Almost a year has passed since I started
my senior
year.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If my performance has managed to
inspire
younger racers, I can't think of
anything more
worthwhile.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: You're not planning to stop now, are you?

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Don't worry, there's no chance
of that.
Can't you see the fire in my
eyes?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'm already looking to the
future. My
next challenge will be...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Precisely.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But this will be no repeat of last year. I
intend to
show the world the fruits of my
labors.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф looks fired up enough
already,
but I have one more thing to
tell her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I hear Марузенски's going to be there.

text_block_list.text: Марузенски. I see...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: On the way back...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, is that...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...And that concludes our tour of the
academy.
Do you have any questions?
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Yes, the student council's general
manager. It
looks like she's leading a
group of Umamusume
around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, today was the
day that
the new student council
members were supposed
to be given a
guided tour.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know... I'm starting to think that
maybe the
student council might not be
right for me...
text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Why do you say that?
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
I joined because of the President, but
when I saw
her race today...
text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
She was so much better than I could ever
hope to
be. I feel like there's no point...
text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф says nothing. She's
waiting to see
how the general manager
will respond.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. I felt exactly the
same way
when I first joined.
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
I thought there was no way I could ever
live up to
my station, and it made me
feel really down on
myself.
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I still feel useless most of the
time. But I
can tell you one thing for
certain: I've grown a lot
as a person
since I began.
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
So if you want to improve yourself...
would you
consider hanging in a little
longer?
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text: A-all right... I'll give it a shot!
text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume

text_block_list.text: Heh.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's gratifying to see the younger
students
maturing off the track as well as
on it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And it's a relief to know that the
academy will be
in safe hands even after
I'm gone.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф looks like a weight has
been lifted
from her shoulders. This is
the perfect time to
spring my proposal!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
There's something I've been meaning to ask
you.

text_block_list.text: That's rather sudden, but by all means.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
I want you to forget about your titles at the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
I don't want her to race as the Emperor
or the
President, but simply as Symboli
Rudolf.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I understand what you're trying to say.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But my pride as the Emperor won't allow
it. The
weight of my responsibilities is
what makes me
who I am.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What's the harm in setting all that aside
once in a
while?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув! I didn't see you there.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I was assisting with the tour. But
more to
the point...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I concur with your trainer's suggestion.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Every time you race, you hold your real
self back
in order to be more true to
your ideals.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But now your successors are well on their
way to
maturity. I think, just once, you
should race the
way you truly want to.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I have raced the way I wanted to. This is the path I chose when I became the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Why must you insist on
being so
hardheaded?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: How about this, then? Do it for us.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: For you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to see how you would
race if
you let your heart guide you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
If you let yourself be nothing more than
an
Umamusume seeking a challenge.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I believe I speak for the entire student
council
when I say we would relish the
learning
experience.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
So, in your capacity as president... would
you
show us what it looks like when you
race as
Симболи Рудольф?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Sigh... You know exactly how to pull my strings, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I've been at this for a while now, you
know.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Very well. You win. If both my trainer
and my own
right hand turn against me,
what am I to do?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
When I race in the Arima Kinen, I will let
the titles
of Emperor and President fall
by the wayside.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: As for what will come of it, I cannot say.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Heh...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Me neither. It will be a learning
experience for
both of us.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
